questions.text: Describe a complex Python application you built. What architectural decisions did you make and why?
How do you approach testing in Python? Walk me through your testing strategy for a production service.
Explain how you handle state management in frontend applications. What patterns have worked best for you?
Describe a performance optimization you implemented in a React application. What was the measurable impact?
How do you approach database schema design for a new feature? Walk through your process from requirements to implementation.
Describe how you would design an API for a service that needs to handle millions of requests daily.
Walk me through your approach to containerizing an application and setting up its deployment pipeline.
Describe a machine learning project you worked on. How did you validate your model's performance?
How do you handle concurrency and thread safety in Java applications?
Describe a cloud architecture you designed. How did you handle scalability and cost optimization?
How do you approach security in your applications? Describe a security challenge you solved.
What unique challenges have you encountered in mobile development compared to web development?
Tell me about a time you had to resolve a significant disagreement within your team. What was the outcome?
Describe a situation where you had to deliver difficult feedback to a colleague. How did you approach it?
Tell me about a project that failed or didn't meet expectations. What did you learn?
Describe a time you had to quickly learn a new technology or domain to complete a project.
How do you prioritize when you have multiple urgent tasks competing for your attention?
Tell me about a time you went above and beyond your role to help your team succeed.
Walk me through a project you're most proud of. What was your specific contribution?
Describe a time you had to make a significant technical trade-off. What factors did you consider?
Tell me about a time you improved an existing system significantly. What metrics showed the improvement?
Describe a project where requirements changed significantly mid-development. How did you adapt?
Walk me through how you would approach building a system from scratch given ambiguous requirements.

Describe how you make architectural decisions that affect multiple teams.
What strategies do you use to learn new codebases quickly?
Describe a personal project that demonstrates your passion for software development.
How do you balance technical debt against new feature delivery?
How do you ensure your implementations match design specifications while maintaining accessibility?
How do you approach monitoring and observability for services you build?
How do you decide where to put business logic — frontend, backend, or shared?
What aspects of this role are you most excited about, and where do you see the biggest challenges?
